correctness.rationale: The poset is reconstructed from the thirteen covers independently read from the cited Figure 1. The package enumerates all 12,575 monotone self-maps, computes every fixed subset, and replays an explicit valid beat-point deletion sequence for each of the 209 proper realized fixed subsets. The full fixed set occurs once and forces the identity; its noncontractibility is a cited premise from Cianci--Ottina. The dual statement follows because order reversal preserves monotone self-maps and swaps up- and down-beat points.

value.rationale: The object is the extremal nine-point homotopically trivial noncontractible finite space (up to order duality), so the topology of fixed sets of its self-maps is a natural structural invariant. The theorem sharply isolates the identity as the only self-map whose fixed set retains the ambient noncontractibility; all 12,574 nonidentity maps have contractible fixed sets. This refines known fixed-point/selection results rather than merely recomputing a table.
